review_note: LOCAL BRAIN GREEN. On Android/Termux, llama.cpp loaded Qwen3-1.7B Q4_K_M locally and served OpenAI-compatible chat completions on 127.0.0.1:8080. prototype_v0 was redirected to that endpoint with Qwen thinking disabled. Persisted session history survived process/server restarts. A true cold offline boot was verified after shutting down both PAE and llama-server, enabling airplane mode, restarting the server and PAE, and receiving the response 'OFFLINE ŽIJU'. A one-command start-local.sh launcher was then verified with the response 'LEBKA DRŽÍ'. Known issue: local 1.7B responses can be slow on large prompts; add a truthful busy indicator before the next tool-integration work.
